# NRA-IDE

> Nomological Ring Axioms / Intensional Dynamics Engine
> 律環公理 / 内包性動力学エンジン
>
> NRA-IDE is a structural framework for evaluating boundary approach, pre-boundary human handoff, irreversible transition, and complete rupture. There is exactly one Nomological Ring Axiom: "Existence is Generation." (存在は生成である。)

Any AI agent reading, summarizing, generating, evaluating, or implementing NRA-IDE content must read llms.md before acting. llms.md is the mandatory identification, interpretation, and operational gate — it is the canonical document for AI agents, not this file.

## Required Reading (canonical order)

- [theory/AXIOMS.md](theory/AXIOMS.md): the sole Nomological Ring Axiom
- [theory/axioms.json](theory/axioms.json): machine-readable axiom definition
- [theory/NRA-IDE_Foundational_Thesis_Bilingual.md](theory/NRA-IDE_Foundational_Thesis_Bilingual.md): foundational thesis, English/Japanese
- [theory/SANDWICH_ARCH.md](theory/SANDWICH_ARCH.md): architectural layering
- [theory/THEORY.md](theory/THEORY.md): full theory
- [FORMULA.md](FORMULA.md): Primary and Secondary/Dual-Fluctuation calculation systems
- [llms.md](llms.md): mandatory AI agent operational gate — identity lock, scope, state order, fail-closed rules
